mechanism_narrative: A sustained collapse in WORKPLACES mobility reduces weekday trip chains and discretionary stopovers, pulling RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks as commuting-linked spending weakens.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall below its prior 4-week mean over the next 28 days after WORKPLACES remains sharply below baseline for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT drops more than 5 points week-on-week, access friction rises immediately and retail trips are deferred, so RETAIL_REC falls within two weeks and stays weaker through week four.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises or stays flat over the next 14 days after a week-on-week TRANSIT decline exceeding 5 points.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in RESIDENTIAL and fall in WORKPLACES indicates households are staying home more and commuting less, which reduces retail visitation and pushes RETAIL_REC lower over the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline relative to the prior 4-week average when RESIDENTIAL rises and WORKPLACES falls in the same weekly window.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT remains below -40 and WORKPLACES stays below -30 for two consecutive weeks, a restriction-like environment is active and retail footfall keeps contracting over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT below -40 and WORKPLACES below -30 for 2 consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not remain below its preceding 4-week mean after both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES stay below the stated thresholds for two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: An elevated PARKS reading above +50 signals weather- or leisure-driven substitution toward outdoor activity, which diverts discretionary spending away from retail and lowers RETAIL_REC over the next week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases in the next 7 days after PARKS crosses above +50.

mechanism_narrative: A worsening in GROCERY_PHARM alongside a drop in RETAIL_REC indicates households are concentrating trips on essentials and cutting discretionary shopping, which makes RETAIL_REC fall further over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rebounds within 14 days despite GROCERY_PHARM remaining more negative than its prior week.

mechanism_narrative: A continued slide in WORKPLACES is a leading indicator of weaker weekday consumer traffic, so RETAIL_REC will be lower over the next four weeks than over the last four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not stay below the previous 28-day average even though WORKPLACES continues to deteriorate.

mechanism_narrative: In a reopening regime, if TRANSIT begins to recover while WORKPLACES remains deeply negative, retail activity initially lags and RETAIL_REC is lower over the next four weeks because mobility is still concentrated in non-shopping trips.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its last 4-week mean within 28 days while TRANSIT improves and WORKPLACES stays strongly negative.
